propositions: The primary completion-verify agent step has no loop breaker and exhausts the step budget (240 requests) on repetitive tool calls instead of landing a verdict.
Tool calls repeat in cycles (k >= 2) that the existing max_consecutive_repeat metric cannot detect, causing runs to burn 40–70% of budget on redundant work.
A windowed distinct-ratio discriminator (window 24, trip <= 0.50) reliably detects pathological cycles while never aborting healthy runs with genuine breadth.
When a runaway is detected, the run must raise RunawayToolLoopError before executing the repeated call, route into bounded recovery, and emit a verdict with a diagnostic naming the loop.
Both kill paths (request_limit and tool_calls_limit) are bounded as failure conditions; no new workload ceiling is introduced.
